description: How long an answer from one of the FAA's SWIM feeds (the planner's /api/live/*) is fresh and how often a screen showing it asks again: a runway's RVR each minute, as it is updated (AIM 7-1-13), the ITWS alerts and special activity airspace's SFDPS status as often (the app's choice), the Command Center's programs every five minutes, and the D-ATIS and a flight's tower departures fresh for five minutes and not polled (the app's choice).

fresh_s.description: How long an answer is fresh, seconds.

poll_s.description: How often a screen showing it asks again, seconds; null where it is not polled.
